# proxmox_sdn_subnet (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN subnet from `/cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/subnets/{subnet}`. Subnets are only addressable inside their VNet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_subnet" "app" {
  vnet   = proxmox_sdn_vnet.app.vnet
  subnet = "10.0.0.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subnet` (String) CIDR of the subnet to read.
- `vnet` (String) VNet that owns the subnet.

### Read-Only

- `dns_zone_prefix` (String)
- `gateway` (String)
- `id` (String) Subnet identifier (`<vnet>/<subnet>`).
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `snat` (Boolean)
- `state` (String)
